ideas.pitch: An AI-powered automated review platform for educators and institutions to scan lesson plans and syllabus drafts for hidden biases, misinformation, outdated facts, and pedagogical consistency using custom LLM evaluation rubrics.
ideas.title: EduShield AI Curriculum Vulnerability Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of AI with Education by solving a real-world workflow problem for teachers and school administrators who are rapidly adopting generative AI without quality control tools.

ideas.pitch: An educational platform for university student teams that breaks down hackathon or semester-long project requirements into milestone tasks, uses AI to automatically parse meeting transcripts into contribution logs, and maps them to academic grading rubrics.
ideas.title: PeerScribe: AI Group Project Accountability & Rubric Mapping Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves as students and educators dealing with team friction and unstructured group assignments in project-based learning.

ideas.pitch: An AI language-learning application tailored for regional students that teaches complex technical subjects by dynamically blending regional languages with technical English through interactive conversational roleplay.
ideas.title: VocabQuest: Adaptive Multilingual AI Code-Switching Tutor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses accessibility and language barriers in technical education, appealing directly to regional educational inclusion goals valued by judges in student hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first educational utility that ingests heavy PDF textbooks, research papers, or syllabus documents, extracts core concepts, and automatically generates interactive spaced-repetition flashcards and conceptual knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: Syllabus2Flashcard Automated Knowledge Graph Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate, measurable utility for students studying under tight exam deadlines, hitting high marks on practical execution and problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: An interactive voice-based AI examiner that conducts simulated viva voce examinations for engineering students, asking follow-up questions based on their verbal explanations of code repositories or project architecture diagrams.
ideas.title: VivaVoce: AI Mock Examiner for Technical Vivas and Interviews
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines software development evaluation with product thinking, directly addressing the anxiety and preparation gaps students face during university practical exams.
